content: बिल्वः A species of tree, Aegle Marmelos or wood-apple; its leaves are used in the worship of Śiva. .{@-ल्वम्@} .²1 The fruit of this tree; बिल्वं बालं कषायोष्णं पाचनं वह्निदीपनम् . संग्राहि तिक्तकटुकं तीक्ष्णं वातकफापहम् .. <ls>Bhāva P.</ls> .²2 A particular weight (= one pala). .²3 A small pond or pool.
